description: Search Amazon for new mum / postpartum gifts on the user's marketplace. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED.

name: search_gifts
title: Search new mum gifts
